info.title: OpenAoK
info.author: Zaydme
info.description: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings, from your own CD
info.details:
OpenAoK is an engine for Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings (1999), written from scratch, that plays the game from your own copy of the original CD. The download holds none of the game: you make its data on a computer from your CD and copy the folder to the SD card beside the app, as the guide at zaydme.github.io/openaok/guide/switch says.

- Random maps from the game's own scripts, the computer players' own AI scripts, the campaigns, scenarios and the scenario editor
- In handheld mode the touch screen plays: tap to click, hold for a right click, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom
- The controller plays as a mouse and the game's hotkeys: left stick moves the pointer, right stick scrolls, A clicks, B right-clicks, X goes to the next idle villager, + opens the game menu

Hold R while starting a game so the Homebrew Menu opens with all of the console's memory, which OpenAoK needs. Its files, the game's data, profile and saved games, live in sdmc:/switch/openaok/. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

changelog:
0.6.6
- Black Forest, Crater Lake, Gold Rush and Team Islands are played from their own map scripts
- The game setup's settings are as wide as the original's, and its lists show every choice
- The game setup offers the original's Time Limit and Score victories
- A computer player answers a blow in its town with every soldier free to come
